description: Autodesk, Inc. is a global leader in 3D design, engineering and entertainment technology solutions, spanning architecture, engineering, construction, product design, manufacturing, media and entertainment. Its customers design, fabricate, manufacture and build anything by visualizing, simulating and analyzing real-world performance early in the design process, which allows them to foster innovation, optimize their designs, streamline manufacturing and construction processes, save time and money, improve quality, deliver more sustainable outcomes, communicate plans and collaborate with others. Its professional software products are sold globally through a combination of indirect and direct channels, and its product families include Tandem, a cloud-based platform that transforms the built asset lifecycle and helps architecture, engineering, construction and operations firms harness BIM data to create and hand over a digital twin, and AutoCAD, a customizable and extensible CAD application for professional design, drafting, detailing and visualization.
